：少宗主赏的（：少宗主赏的（第22页）另外，当初我去秘境，对我苍灵峰也有些照顾。还有那部功法，你要是愿意的话也可以分享给他。”“是，少宗主！”萧元真将两只玉瓶和玉简小心翼翼地收入怀中，再次躬身行礼，然后步伐轻快而又不失恭敬地退出了苍灵峰。离开苍灵峰后，萧元真强忍着内心的激动，速度都比平时快了将近一倍。他一路疾行，很快便在执法堂找到了正在翻阅案件卷宗的方伯礼。方伯礼看到萧元真满脸红光、眉飞色舞的模样，放下手中的卷宗，忍不住笑着打趣道：“呦，什么风把你吹来了？看你这样子，是捡到宝了还是修为大涨？”萧元真也不多话，从怀中取出那只玉瓶，递到了方伯礼面前，下巴微微扬起，脸上写满了得意之色：“凝元丹。”方伯礼闻言一愣，手中的茶杯停在半空中，整个人像是被施了定身术一样僵在原地。他不可置信地望着萧元真，好半晌才放下茶杯，一把接过玉瓶，拔开瓶塞凑到鼻尖仔细闻了闻。那股浓郁而精纯的药香让他整个人为之一振。确实是凝元丹，而且是品质极好的上品凝元丹，比他当年在宗门丹堂见过的那枚样品还要纯上几分。他震惊得脱口而出，声音都高了八度：“这可是凝元丹啊！老萧，你真的要把这么珍贵的东西给我？”苍玄宗内，筑基后期的内门弟子少说也有二三十人，哪一个不是眼巴巴地盯着宗门每年那寥寥几颗的凝元丹名额？这种级别的丹药可不是想要就能要的，那是极为珍贵的战略资源，每一颗的分配都要经过长老会的反复讨论和权衡。只有对宗门做出过重大贡献的弟子才有可能获得一颗，或者是天赋极其强悍、被长老们一致看好能冲击金丹的核心弟子，也能破格拿到一颗。其他的筑基后期弟子，就只能慢慢熬资历、攒贡献，有的人熬到寿元耗尽都没等到属于自己的那一颗。之前萧元真因为发掘了林枫这块璞玉，掌门何元岳龙颜大悦，破例赏了他一颗凝元丹，那已经是让同门师兄弟们羡慕得眼珠子都快掉出来的待遇了。如今萧元真手里又多了一颗，而且品质比之前那颗更好，这让他心里既兴奋又感慨。萧元真笑着摇了摇头，语气坦诚而真挚，没有半分居功自傲的意思：“这颗凝元丹可不是我的功劳，我哪敢随便认。是少宗主特意嘱咐我带给你的。少宗主点名给你的，我可不敢贪这份功。”“少宗主给的？”方伯礼瞪大了眼睛，一时间竟然有些不敢相信自己的耳朵。当初林枫刚入宗门的时候，他也是觉得林枫是掌门的关门弟子，照顾了一下是必须的。想着以后结个善缘。就分配了三个执法堂的弟子过去帮忙，又亲自带林枫熟悉了一下宗门的环境和规矩。这些事对他而言不过是小事一件，他从来没有想过要图什么回报。没想到还有回报。

: Rewarded by the Young Sect Master (: Rewarded by the Young Sect Master (page 22) In addition, when I went to the secret realm, I also took some care of me at Cangling Peak. And that skill, you can share it with him if you are willing." "Yes, Young Sect Master!" Xiao Yuanzhen carefully put the two jade vases and jade slips into his arms, bowed again, and then exited Cangling Peak with brisk yet respectful steps. After leaving Cangling Peak, Xiao Yuanzhen Suppressing the excitement in his heart, his speed was nearly twice as fast as usual. He walked quickly and soon found Fang Boli who was looking through the case files in the law enforcement hall. Fang Boli saw Xiao Yuanzhen's face flushed and beaming. He put down the file in his hand and couldn't help but smile and joked: "Hey, what brought you here? Looking at you, did you find a treasure or your cultivation level has greatly improved?" He took out the jade bottle and handed it to Fang Boli. He raised his chin slightly and said with a proud look on his face: "Condensing Yuan Pill." Fang Boli was stunned when he heard this. The tea cup in his hand stopped in mid-air, and his whole figure looked like He froze in place as if he had been cast on a restraining spell. He looked at Xiao Yuanzhen in disbelief for a long time before putting down the tea cup, taking the jade bottle, uncorking it and bringing it to his nose to smell the rich and pure medicinal fragrance. His whole body was shaken. It was indeed the Ning Yuan Pill, and it was a high-quality Ning Yuan Pill. It was much purer than the sample he had seen in the sect's Dan Hall. He was so shocked that he blurted out, his voice rising an octave: "This is the Ning Yuan Pill! Old Xiao, do you really want to give me such a precious thing?" There were at least twenty or thirty disciples of the inner sect in the late stage of foundation building in Cangxuan Sect, and none of them were jealous. Are you staring at the few quotas for the sect's Condensing Pills every year? This level of pills is not something you can just want. It is an extremely precious strategic resource. The allocation of each pill must be repeatedly discussed and weighed by the Elders Council. Only disciples who have made significant contributions to the sect can get one, or core disciples who are extremely talented and are unanimously optimistic about the golden pill can also get it. One pill. Other disciples in the later stage of Foundation Establishment can only slowly earn their qualifications and accumulate contributions. Some people have not waited until their longevity was exhausted. Previously, because Xiao Yuanzhen discovered Lin Feng's rough jade, the leader He Yuanyue Longyan was very happy and gave him an Yuan Ning Dan. This was a treatment that made his fellow disciples almost fall out of their eyes with envy. Now Xiao Yuanzhen has another one in his hand, and its quality is also great. It was better than the previous one, which made him feel both excited and emotional. Xiao Yuanzhen smiled and shook his head, his tone was honest and sincere, without any hint of arrogance: "This Yuan Ning Dan is not my work, how can I dare to admit it casually. I was specially asked by the Young Sect Master to bring it to you. The Young Sect Master gave it to you by name, and I don't dare to covet the credit." "Young Sect Master gave it to you?" Fang Boli's eyes widened, and he felt a little uncomfortable for a moment. He dared to believe his ears. When Lin Feng first joined the sect, he felt that it was necessary to take care of him. Thinking of forming a good relationship in the future, he assigned three disciples from the Law Enforcement Hall to help him, and personally familiarized Lin Feng with the sect's environment and rules. These things were just a small thing for him, and he never expected to get anything in return.
